# ai-memory competitive-advantage facet register (appendix)

> Companion appendix to [US-AGENT-MEMORY-MARKET-3x3-AUDIT-2026-09-27.md](US-AGENT-MEMORY-MARKET-3x3-AUDIT-2026-09-27.md), Part II: the full 182-facet evidence register (Codex gpt-6-astra high; CodeGraph on release/v1.0.0).


### 6. Full facet register and evidence

#### 6.1 Binding register

“Default” gives activation, not reliability. ON means automatic on the named applicable path; it does not mean a server is running, identities are enrolled, keys are provisioned or optional integrations are enabled. PARTIAL means mixed paths or prerequisites and must be read with its configuration text. Every row links to a complete record with symbols, mechanism, tests, comparator findings and boundaries.

#### 6.2 Remaining full facet records

Sections 2 and 3 contain all UNIQUE/HIGH and RARE records. This section supplies the other 125 records: UNIQUE with MEDIUM/LOW value and TABLE-STAKES. No mechanism is dropped because its competitive value is weak.

<a id="facet-f1-01"></a>
#### F1-01 — Fifteen typed memory kinds in one persistent record


**Class/value:** TABLE-STAKES (TABLE-STAKES 3/3) · LOW (LOW 2/3, MEDIUM 1/3). **Code reality:** REAL-DEFAULT. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** No applicable report mapped in the two-label snapshot.

**What it is:** Fifteen typed memory kinds in one persistent record.

**Implementing symbols:** MemoryKind [src/models/memory.rs:64](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/models/memory.rs#L64); Memory [src/models/memory.rs:1178](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/models/memory.rs#L1178); insert_inner [src/storage/mod.rs:2268](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L2268); memories_by_kind [src/storage/mod.rs:8040](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L8040).

**Mechanism:**

1. MemoryKind is a serde snake_case enum: observation, reflection, persona, concept, entity, claim, relation, event, conversation, decision, goal, plan, step, told, instruction. Memory carries the discriminator alongside UUID, tier, lifecycle, version and provenance fields.
2. The storage insert serializes the kind to a SQL column; readers parse it and filters select it. Omitted kind resolves to Observation. This gives tools a shared, queryable classification instead of relying on prose tags.

**Default / activation / configuration:** ON — Request memory_kind; default observation. No enable flag. Non-default kinds require a supplied kind or a producing tool.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [src/models/memory.rs:3161](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/models/memory.rs#L3161)::memory_kind_round_trips_every_variant_string; [src/models/memory.rs:3256](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/models/memory.rs#L3256)::memory_kind_default_is_observation; [tests/upsert_merge_field_set_coherence_2394_2395.rs:392](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/upsert_merge_field_set_coherence_2394_2395.rs#L392)::upsert_adopted_kind_takes_the_incoming_provenance_verbatim_2394.

**Competitor finding:** 11. KIP / AndaDB Nexus; Cognee; iii/agentmemory; TencentDB Agent Memory; Vestige; Hindsight; Graphiti; Redis Agent Memory; MemMachine; Neo4j Agent Memory (direct Bolt); Chroma / Foundation Typed records are common; fifteen enum variants is a taxonomy choice, not fifteen advantages. Competitors use different typed schemas rather than ai-memory's exact discriminator.

**Class/value:** TABLE-STAKES (TABLE-STAKES 3/3) · HIGH (HIGH 3/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Claim valid-time intervals independent of write timestamps.

**Implementing symbols:** Memory [src/models/memory.rs:1353](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/models/memory.rs#L1353); UpdateMemory [src/models/memory.rs:2057](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/models/memory.rs#L2057); build_list_query [src/storage/mod.rs:7833](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L7833); recall [src/storage/mod.rs:8671](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L8671); merge_memory [src/models/crdt_merge.rs:596](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/models/crdt_merge.rs#L596).

**Mechanism:**

1. Memory stores immutable valid_from and closable valid_until separately from created_at/updated_at. Input instants are validated/canonicalized; query valid_at applies (start is NULL or start <= t) AND (end is NULL or end > t).
2. List, keyword and hybrid recall use this half-open interval; an omitted query imposes no valid-time filter. Archive/restore carries the bounds, and same-ID merge preserves local valid_from while preferring a present close over absence.

**Default / activation / configuration:** ON — Optional request valid_from/valid_until and query valid_at. No enable flag; NULL endpoints are unbounded.

**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · LOW (LOW 3/3). **Code reality:** REAL-DEFAULT. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** No applicable report mapped in the two-label snapshot.

**What it is:** Stable content-addressed genesis identity beside mutable UUID records.

**Implementing symbols:** canonical_cid_preimage [src/identity/cid.rs:154](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/identity/cid.rs#L154); compute_cid [src/identity/cid.rs:197](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/identity/cid.rs#L197); stamp_memory_cid [src/identity/cid.rs:237](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/identity/cid.rs#L237); verify_cid [src/identity/cid.rs:286](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/identity/cid.rs#L286); merge_memory [src/models/crdt_merge.rs:583](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/models/crdt_merge.rs#L583).

**Mechanism:**

1. canonical_cid_preimage concatenates a domain prefix and separated author, namespace, secret-screened title, kind, canonical microsecond creation instant and SHA-256 of screened content. BLAKE3 over that preimage produces b3:<hex>.
2. The UUID remains the primary/foreign key. The separate cid and cid_genesis are persisted at genesis and preserved through edits and merges; verify_cid recomputes the outer hash from stored genesis rather than treating current mutable text as genesis.

**Default / activation / configuration:** ON — Genesis minting automatic. AI_MEMORY_CID_ENFORCE=1 changes mismatch logging from INFO to WARN; default detect-and-log. Neither setting rejects a federated write (src/config.rs:5061).

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [tests/cid_tamper_detection.rs:35](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/cid_tamper_detection.rs#L35)::tamper_is_detected; [tests/cid_tamper_detection.rs:123](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/cid_tamper_detection.rs#L123)::consistent_reforge_not_caught_by_cid_alone; [src/identity/cid.rs:447](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/identity/cid.rs#L447)::cid_is_stable_across_created_at_renderings_3446.

**Competitor finding:** 0. No equivalent established at this scope in the assessed source corpus. Content addressing and canonical IDs are common. No frozen genesis-preimage-plus-mutable-UUID equivalent was established. The unkeyed CID permits consistent re-forging, so this is an identity invariant rather than author authenticity.

**Competitor code evidence:** [K@121](#e-k-121) ([source 1](https://github.com/ldclabs/anda-db/blob/d781b47b646076c3b17a2b20cfc44128f43c8124/rs/anda_cognitive_nexus/src/capsule/mod.rs#L50-L85); [source 2](https://github.com/ldclabs/anda-db/blob/d781b47b646076c3b17a2b20cfc44128f43c8124/rs/anda_cognitive_nexus/src/capsule/mod.rs#L548-L617)); [CL@49](#e-cl-49) ([source 1](https://github.com/sheawinkler/ContextLattice/blob/e0daa914fc3f3a9a21363470242ea3fc0bd88964/services/gateway-go/memory_store.go#L75); [source 2](https://github.com/sheawinkler/ContextLattice/blob/e0daa914fc3f3a9a21363470242ea3fc0bd88964/services/gateway-go/memory_store.go#L1555)); [HS@72](#e-hs-72) ([source 1](https://github.com/deepset-ai/haystack/blob/8a5406eea71a0fc19e94c4b9a5cd96df2158a45a/haystack/dataclasses/document.py#L18-L54); [source 2](https://github.com/deepset-ai/haystack/blob/8a5406eea71a0fc19e94c4b9a5cd96df2158a45a/haystack/dataclasses/document.py#L95-L116)); [MS@47](#e-ms-47) ([source 1](https://github.com/zilliztech/memsearch/blob/2a4652fa086fbd45e92bfd8da7781ebe1642baa7/src/memsearch/chunker.py#L48); [source 2](https://github.com/zilliztech/memsearch/blob/2a4652fa086fbd45e92bfd8da7781ebe1642baa7/src/memsearch/chunker.py#L65)).

**Open defects / gates:** None applicable identified in the refreshed `found-in-testing` / `ga-blocker` union; absence of a mapped report is not a correctness guarantee.

**Release qualification:** Stable genesis commitments are real. A coherent rewrite of CID plus genesis passes; this is neither immutable storage nor author authentication. No applicable open report identified in the two queried label sets.

**Claim boundary:** An unkeyed hash detects inconsistency, not a coherent rewrite by a database attacker. cid_genesis contains identity fields and a content digest; erasure must scrub it. Legacy unverifiable rows can have NULL cid.

#### F1-08 — Bounded derivation DAG with cycle refusal and retained ancestor identifiers


**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 3/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Bounded derivation DAG with cycle refusal and retained ancestor identifiers.

**Implementing symbols:** MemoryLinkRelation::LINEAGE [src/models/link.rs:342](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/models/link.rs#L342); lineage_edge_is_forward [src/storage/mod.rs:9481](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L9481); lineage_ancestor_reachable [src/storage/mod.rs:9564](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L9564); lineage_traverse [src/storage/mod.rs:13236](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L13236); PostgresStore::lineage_traverse [src/store/postgres/lineage.rs:370](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/postgres/lineage.rs#L370).

**Mechanism:**

1. The lineage subset is derived_from, reflects_on and derives_from. Link admission checks temporal direction and, for equal-time ambiguity, a recursive reachability probe that refuses cycles or an exhausted safety budget.
2. Recursive CTE traversal carries a visited path, caps public depth at five, groups repeated nodes, and returns edge CID with row-CID fallback. Ancestor and descendant walks reverse source/target roles; retained tombstones permit lineage continuity.

**Default / activation / configuration:** ON — AI_MEMORY_LINEAGE_DAG / [storage].lineage_dag defaults true after boot resolution (src/config.rs:10149). max_depth bounds each walk.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs:426](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs#L426)::equal_instant_two_cycle_is_refused; [tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs:493](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs#L493)::traversal_terminates_on_corrupt_cycle; [tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs:643](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs#L643)::lineage_depth_budget_is_enforced.

**Competitor finding:** 0. No equivalent established at this scope in the assessed source corpus. Other products retain derivation/provenance and KIP detects dependency cycles at read time. No full match to admission-time DAG rejection, retained tombstone identities and bounded traversal was established. The five-hop cap and stale AGE limit containment completeness.

**Competitor code evidence:** [K@97](#e-k-97) ([source 1](https://github.com/ldclabs/anda-db/blob/d781b47b646076c3b17a2b20cfc44128f43c8124/rs/anda_cognitive_nexus/src/projection/mod.rs#L1408-L1430); [source 2](https://github.com/ldclabs/anda-db/blob/d781b47b646076c3b17a2b20cfc44128f43c8124/rs/anda_cognitive_nexus/src/projection/mod.rs#L111-L161)); [Co@103](#e-co-103) ([source 1](https://github.com/topoteretes/cognee/blob/eb90d03740755f5252b8b12cce91fd09970f2d81/cognee/modules/provenance/edge_evidence/config.py#L1-L19); [source 2](https://github.com/topoteretes/cognee/blob/eb90d03740755f5252b8b12cce91fd09970f2d81/cognee/modules/cognify/config.py#L20-L22)); [G@38](#e-g-38) ([source 1](https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/blob/6b4b56ff6f4b1e4e69c3c3c5487cf1b8762c483a/graphiti_core/nodes.py#L318); [source 2](https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/blob/6b4b56ff6f4b1e4e69c3c3c5487cf1b8762c483a/graphiti_core/nodes.py#L499)).

**Open defects / gates:** [#3946](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/3946). Exact titles, labels and scope caveats are in §6.3.

**Release qualification:** Cycle refusal and bounded walks ship; PostgreSQL projection incompleteness prevents treating them as a complete containment closure. Open: #3946. Issue scope/types are in the facet record.

**Claim boundary:** This is bounded provenance reachability, not unlimited transitive closure. PostgreSQL deferred mode uses relational CTE; sync AGE can still miss an edge queued after a projection failure.

#### F1-09 — Transactional consolidation with retained source tombstones


**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · LOW (LOW 2/3, MEDIUM 1/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Transactional consolidation with retained source tombstones.

**Implementing symbols:** consolidate [src/storage/mod.rs:10641](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L10641); source disposition [src/storage/mod.rs:10956](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L10956); emit_consolidate_leaf [src/revisions.rs:534](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/revisions.rs#L534); PostgresStore::consolidate [src/store/postgres.rs:28135](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/postgres.rs#L28135).

**Mechanism:**

1. consolidate opens a write transaction, reads sources, inserts the summary memory, and appends identity-only consolidation leaves. With tombstoning enabled it adds derived_from links then changes each still-visible source to tombstoned.
2. It requires each source UPDATE to affect one row and rolls the database work back on failure. Turning tombstoning off invokes hard deletion instead. Summary metadata retains source attribution and uses conservative source-confidence aggregation.

**Default / activation / configuration:** PARTIAL — [storage].consolidate_tombstone_sources / AI_MEMORY_CONSOLIDATE_TOMBSTONE_SOURCES defaults to lineage_dag (ON); explicit consolidation operation still required.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs:128](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs#L128)::multi_hop_ancestry_store_reflect_consolidate; [tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs:248](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs#L248)::consolidate_emits_exactly_one_leaf_per_source; [tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs:599](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/lineage_dag_g13.rs#L599)::consolidate_flag_off_preserves_legacy.

**Competitor finding:** 0. No equivalent established at this scope in the assessed source corpus. Competitors consolidate and some preserve inputs, but no complete equivalent to this summary-plus-source-tombstones transaction was established from the cited paths. ai-memory's placeholder, empty-summary and stale-source defects prevent a dependable semantic-preservation claim.

**Competitor code evidence:** [OV@107](#e-ov-107) ([source 1](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/blob/a09a9d20a8e07d08973aee177802d00e08df29e6/openviking/storage/transaction/__init__.py#L3-L8); [source 2](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/blob/a09a9d20a8e07d08973aee177802d00e08df29e6/openviking/storage/queuefs/named_queue.py#L60-L69)); [K@96](#e-k-96) ([source 1](https://github.com/ldclabs/anda-db/blob/d781b47b646076c3b17a2b20cfc44128f43c8124/rs/anda_cognitive_nexus/src/tx.rs#L1000-L1020); [source 2](https://github.com/ldclabs/anda-db/blob/d781b47b646076c3b17a2b20cfc44128f43c8124/rs/anda_cognitive_nexus/src/store/control.rs#L125-L164)); [RF@85](#e-rf-85) ([source 1](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/blob/d37f283c6e040af9ab12c7e59d2b222a730c9842/v3/@claude-flow/memory/src/consolidator.ts#L118-L145); [source 2](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/blob/d37f283c6e040af9ab12c7e59d2b222a730c9842/v3/@claude-flow/memory/src/consolidator.ts#L181-L224)); [H@44](#e-h-44) ([source 1](https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/blob/ccfe85b4851957ac2adf88b4a9ddf9668b2882f1/hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/engine/consolidation/consolidator.py#L291); [source 2](https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/blob/ccfe85b4851957ac2adf88b4a9ddf9668b2882f1/hindsight-api-slim/hindsight_api/engine/consolidation/consolidator.py#L353)).

Exact titles, labels and scope caveats are in §6.3.

**Implementing symbols:** RevisionLeaf [src/revisions.rs:105](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/revisions.rs#L105); append_revision_leaf [src/revisions.rs:431](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/revisions.rs#L431); emit_revision_leaf_if_enabled [src/revisions.rs:475](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/revisions.rs#L475); consolidate_leaf_enabled [src/revisions.rs:521](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/revisions.rs#L521); append_only resolver [src/config.rs:10117](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/config.rs#L10117).

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN — AI_MEMORY_APPEND_ONLY=1 or [storage].append_only=true; compiled default false. Consolidation leaves have the separate ON tombstone-source condition.

#### F1-12 — Explicit swarm containment with dry-run and routine freeze


**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 2/3, LOW 1/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Explicit swarm containment with dry-run and routine freeze.

**Implementing symbols:** swarm_rewind [src/storage/mod.rs:13804](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L13804); transaction and CAS [src/storage/mod.rs:13907](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L13907); routine freeze and event [src/storage/mod.rs:14006](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L14006); CLI dispatch [src/cli/commands/swarm_rewind.rs:71](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/cli/commands/swarm_rewind.rs#L71).

**Mechanism:**

1. swarm_rewind previews the root, bounded descendant closure and lineage cost, refusing a missing or already terminal root. The mutating branch opens BEGIN IMMEDIATE, stamps root/descendants contaminated, and freezes explicitly named routines.
2. It CAS-checks root state, appends one signed swarm_rewind event in the same transaction and marks repeat calls idempotent. Dry-run returns the projected changes without writing.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN — Explicit swarm-rewind / memory_swarm_rewind invocation; dry_run and supplied routine IDs control behavior. No background fleet rollback.

#### F1-13 — RAII SQLite write transactions and reusable-connection cleanup


**Class/value:** TABLE-STAKES (TABLE-STAKES 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 2/3, HIGH 1/3). **Code reality:** REAL-DEFAULT. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** RAII SQLite write transactions and reusable-connection cleanup.

**Implementing symbols:** WriteTxn [src/storage/connection.rs:184](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/connection.rs#L184); WriteTxn::commit [src/storage/connection.rs:246](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/connection.rs#L246); Drop [src/storage/connection.rs:291](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/connection.rs#L291); ensure_autocommit [src/storage/connection.rs:322](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/connection.rs#L322).

**Mechanism:**

1. WriteTxn::begin issues BEGIN IMMEDIATE; deferred/exclusive variants are explicit. A successful COMMIT sets finished only after SQL succeeds.
2. Drop calls finish, which rolls back unfinished work; even a failed COMMIT leaves the guard armed. ensure_autocommit cleans up an abandoned transaction before another request can unknowingly inherit its uncommitted state.

**Default / activation / configuration:** ON — No flag. Used by write funnels that explicitly acquire the guard; this is a primitive, not a whole-application transaction guarantee.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [src/storage/connection.rs:1767](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/connection.rs#L1767)::write_txn_rolls_back_on_panic_unwind_and_connection_stays_usable; [src/storage/connection.rs:1807](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/connection.rs#L1807)::write_txn_rolls_back_when_commit_itself_fails; [src/storage/connection.rs:1866](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/connection.rs#L1866)::ensure_autocommit_rolls_back_an_unguarded_transaction.

**Competitor finding:** 5. Vestige; Ruflo (Claude Flow); MemPalace; Cognee; Chroma / Foundation Exception-safe transactional writes are standard engineering in these stacks; Rust RAII is one implementation. This does not prove all higher-level multi-store operations atomic, including ai-memory's split lifecycle patch. LangGraph SQLite cursor commits in finally, so that helper is specifically not credited as rollback-on-exception parity; Memori fact inserts alone also do not establish a encompassing transaction.

**Competitor code evidence:** [V@48](#e-v-48) ([source 1](https://github.com/samvallad33/vestige/blob/9cb6f9c292c95bf1ca385ed04f1641736d24129f/crates/vestige-core/src/storage/sqlite/purge.rs#L7-L41); [source 2](https://github.com/samvallad33/vestige/blob/9cb6f9c292c95bf1ca385ed04f1641736d24129f/crates/vestige-core/src/storage/sqlite/purge.rs#L188-L254)); [RF@127](#e-rf-127) ([source 1](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/blob/d37f283c6e040af9ab12c7e59d2b222a730c9842/v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/memory/memory-initializer.ts#L240-L242); [source 2](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/blob/d37f283c6e040af9ab12c7e59d2b222a730c9842/v3/@claude-flow/memory/src/sqlite-backend.ts#L476-L505)); [MP@71](#e-mp-71) ([source 1](https://github.com/MemPalace/mempalace/blob/8c4865f70c49b6346c53474a9e5684c5f17d3fa9/mempalace/knowledge_graph.py#L111-L139); [source 2](https://github.com/MemPalace/mempalace/blob/8c4865f70c49b6346c53474a9e5684c5f17d3fa9/mempalace/knowledge_graph.py#L160-L183)); [COG@152](#e-cog-152) ([source 1](https://github.com/topoteretes/cognee/blob/eb90d03740755f5252b8b12cce91fd09970f2d81/cognee/infrastructure/databases/relational/sqlalchemy/SqlAlchemyAdapter.py#L119-L145); [source 2](https://github.com/topoteretes/cognee/blob/eb90d03740755f5252b8b12cce91fd09970f2d81/cognee/modules/provenance/storage.py#L71-L115)); [CH@65](#e-ch-65) ([source 1](https://github.com/chroma-core/chroma/blob/e122af79fd42216d6319ff248914a22142c4ab49/rust/types/src/conditional_transaction.rs#L49); [source 2](https://github.com/chroma-core/chroma/blob/e122af79fd42216d6319ff248914a22142c4ab49/rust/types/src/conditional_transaction.rs#L78)).

Exact titles, labels and scope caveats are in §6.3.

**Release qualification:** Rollback-on-drop is sound local transaction hygiene. It cannot make ownership pre-reads or split commits atomic; equivalent database transaction scopes are commonplace. Open: #3152, #3957, #4034. Issue scope/types are in the facet record.

**Claim boundary:** Only operations within the guard share its atomicity. Ownership pre-reads, split lifecycle updates and in-memory indexes can lie outside that boundary.

#### F1-14 — Atomic SAL batch insertion with honest unsupported fallback


**Class/value:** TABLE-STAKES (TABLE-STAKES 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 2/3, HIGH 1/3). **Code reality:** REAL-OPT-IN. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Atomic SAL batch insertion with honest unsupported fallback.

**Implementing symbols:** MemoryStore::store_batch [src/store/mod.rs:1434](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/mod.rs#L1434); SqliteStore::store_batch [src/store/sqlite.rs:543](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/sqlite.rs#L543); PostgresStore::store_batch [src/store/postgres.rs:21494](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/postgres.rs#L21494); PG transaction [src/store/postgres.rs:21577](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/postgres.rs#L21577).

**Mechanism:**

1. SqliteStore::store_batch holds the connection mutex, opens one WriteTxn and inserts every row; any failure rolls back the batch. PostgresStore pre-screens, deduplicates repeated title/namespace slots by last input, then executes the batch in one SQLx transaction.
2. The MemoryStore default returns UnsupportedCapability instead of looping through independent store commits. This makes the batch contract explicit and prevents a partial-write approximation from masquerading as atomic insertion.

**Default / activation / configuration:** ON — When SAL is built and store_batch invoked; Cargo features sal / sal-postgres opt in to that adapter architecture. No runtime batch-atomicity switch.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [tests/sal_parity_batch_atomicity_3181.rs:117](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/sal_parity_batch_atomicity_3181.rs#L117)::sqlite_store_batch_is_all_or_nothing_3181; [tests/sal_parity_batch_atomicity_3181.rs:154](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/sal_parity_batch_atomicity_3181.rs#L154)::sqlite_store_batch_recovers_after_a_failed_batch_3181; [src/store/mod.rs:6066](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/mod.rs#L6066)::default_store_batch_refuses_rather_than_approximating_atomicity_2638.

**Competitor finding:** 3. Ruflo (Claude Flow); Chroma / Foundation; Cognee Ruflo batches native SQLite writes, Chroma conditionally commits buffered operations, and Cognee batches provenance rows transactionally. Their scope differs from SAL memory batches; the all-or-nothing batch primitive is not unique. Honest unsupported-operation errors are contract hygiene.

**Competitor code evidence:** [RF@127](#e-rf-127) ([source 1](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/blob/d37f283c6e040af9ab12c7e59d2b222a730c9842/v3/@claude-flow/cli/src/memory/memory-initializer.ts#L240-L242); [source 2](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/blob/d37f283c6e040af9ab12c7e59d2b222a730c9842/v3/@claude-flow/memory/src/sqlite-backend.ts#L476-L505)); [CH@65](#e-ch-65) ([source 1](https://github.com/chroma-core/chroma/blob/e122af79fd42216d6319ff248914a22142c4ab49/rust/types/src/conditional_transaction.rs#L49); [source 2](https://github.com/chroma-core/chroma/blob/e122af79fd42216d6319ff248914a22142c4ab49/rust/types/src/conditional_transaction.rs#L78)); [COG@152](#e-cog-152) ([source 1](https://github.com/topoteretes/cognee/blob/eb90d03740755f5252b8b12cce91fd09970f2d81/cognee/infrastructure/databases/relational/sqlalchemy/SqlAlchemyAdapter.py#L119-L145); [source 2](https://github.com/topoteretes/cognee/blob/eb90d03740755f5252b8b12cce91fd09970f2d81/cognee/modules/provenance/storage.py#L71-L115)).

**Open defects / gates:** [#4089](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/4089). Exact titles, labels and scope caveats are in §6.3.

**Release qualification:** Atomic database batches are real in the optional SAL build. HTTP inference liveness does not refute the transaction primitive. Open: #4089. Issue scope/types are in the facet record.

**Claim boundary:** Atomicity covers database batch insertion, not peer fan-out or every post-commit event/index stage. #4089 concerns inline HTTP embedding liveness, not loss of SQL batch atomicity. The cited injected-failure tests are SQLite, not proof of every PostgreSQL failure arm.

**Implementing symbols:** VersionConflict [src/storage/mod.rs:3910](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L3910); update_with_expected_version [src/storage/mod.rs:4262](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L4262); Memory::version [src/models/memory.rs:1314](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/models/memory.rs#L1314); SqliteStore::update [src/store/sqlite.rs:821](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/sqlite.rs#L821).

**Mechanism:**

1. Rows start with version=1 and update paths increment it. update_with_expected_version resolves the requested patch and applies a version predicate when expected_version is present; a mismatch returns a typed VersionConflict rather than silently claiming success.
2. Callers can retry after re-reading the winner. Omitting the expected version retains ordinary last-writer behavior; this is an explicit compare-and-swap option, not implicit serializable isolation.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN — MCP expected_version / HTTP If-Match on supporting update surfaces. SAL UpdatePatch does not establish an application-wide required CAS policy.

#### F1-27 — Peer-scoped replay nonces with restart persistence


**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 2/3, HIGH 1/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Peer-scoped replay nonces with restart persistence.

**Implementing symbols:** FederationNonceCache [src/identity/replay.rs:633](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/identity/replay.rs#L633); new_with_db_persistence [src/identity/replay.rs:713](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/identity/replay.rs#L713); record_and_check [src/identity/replay.rs:931](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/identity/replay.rs#L931); receive cache admission [src/handlers/federation_signing_check.rs:2427](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/handlers/federation_signing_check.rs#L2427).

**Mechanism:**

1. After signature verification, FederationNonceCache hashes and records the (peer,nonce) observation and returns Fresh or Replay. It bounds each peer to 10,000 entries and the outer peer set to 1,024, evicting when necessary.
2. The persistent constructor reloads saved fingerprints from SQLite and attempts to persist new observations, so successfully persisted entries survive process recreation. Missing nonce is refused under the default required-nonce policy.

**Default / activation / configuration:** ON — AI_MEMORY_FED_REQUIRE_NONCE defaults ON with signed federation; production persistence uses the configured DB path. In-memory constructors exist for tests.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [tests/federation_nonce_replay_922.rs:228](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/federation_nonce_replay_922.rs#L228)::replay_922_repeated_nonce_returns_401_with_replay_tag; [src/identity/replay.rs:1181](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/identity/replay.rs#L1181)::issue_1255_nonce_persists_across_recreated_cache.

**Competitor finding:** 0. No equivalent established at this scope in the assessed source corpus. No bounded peer nonce cache with verified restart persistence equivalent established. ai-memory persistence failures warn and still admit Fresh, so restart protection is conditional rather than an unconditional default guarantee.

**Competitor code evidence:** [RF@119](#e-rf-119) ([source 1](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/blob/d37f283c6e040af9ab12c7e59d2b222a730c9842/v3/@claude-flow/plugin-agent-federation/src/plugin.ts#L106-L178); [source 2](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/blob/d37f283c6e040af9ab12c7e59d2b222a730c9842/v3/@claude-flow/plugin-agent-federation/src/plugin.ts#L375-L401)); [CL@69](#e-cl-69) ([source 1](https://github.com/sheawinkler/ContextLattice/blob/e0daa914fc3f3a9a21363470242ea3fc0bd88964/services/gateway-go/context_passport.go#L442); [source 2](https://github.com/sheawinkler/ContextLattice/blob/e0daa914fc3f3a9a21363470242ea3fc0bd88964/services/gateway-go/context_mesh.go#L789)).

**Open defects / gates:** [#4024](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/4024). Exact titles, labels and scope caveats are in §6.3.

**Release qualification:** In-memory replay refusal is real, but persistence failure warns and still accepts; restart durability is conditional even with the default nonce requirement. Open: #4024. Issue scope/types are in the facet record.

**Claim boundary:** Bounded caches do not provide permanent replay exclusion. #4024 is the separate operation-nonce-before-CAS ordering defect in transition receive; request-level anti-replay does not make that lane exactly-once. Persistence open/INSERT errors only WARN and leave in-memory protection active (src/identity/replay.rs:859, :880); Fresh is still returned. Restart replay protection is therefore conditional on successful persistence.

**Issue applicability:** [#4024](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/4024) [IMPLEMENTATION-REPORT]. Exact current titles appear in §6.3.

**Implementing symbols:** causal_apply_order [src/federation/mod.rs:352](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/federation/mod.rs#L352); rejections_in_wire_order [src/handlers/federation_receive.rs:1034](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/handlers/federation_receive.rs#L1034); cross-ID warning [src/storage/mod.rs:18493](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L18493).

**Release qualification:** Lexical timestamp/ID ordering is deterministic within one batch, not vector-clock causal order; broken merge and vector attachment remain downstream. Open: #3962, #4030, #4031. Issue scope/types are in the facet record.

#### F1-32 — Operator quarantine release with an atomic audit event


**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 2/3, HIGH 1/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Operator quarantine release with an atomic audit event.

**Implementing symbols:** operator_dequarantine [src/storage/mod.rs:4134](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L4134); dequarantine [src/storage/mod.rs:4211](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L4211); SqliteStore::operator_dequarantine [src/store/sqlite.rs:899](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/sqlite.rs#L899); automatic release [src/handlers/federation_receive.rs:3006](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/handlers/federation_receive.rs#L3006); PG automatic release [src/handlers/federation_signing_check.rs:700](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/handlers/federation_signing_check.rs#L700).

**Mechanism:**

1. operator_dequarantine changes only a row currently quarantined and appends memory.dequarantined in the same transaction. Repeating it is idempotent and does not revive a tombstoned row; the record-stop fence applies.
2. There is also automatic dequarantine after an attested receive succeeds. That path acts on the ID returned by merge and is distinct from the operator transaction and its explicit authority.

**Default / activation / configuration:** PARTIAL — Operator release is explicit; automatic attested-receive release runs without a separate enable flag. Quarantine ingress remains opt-in.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [tests/quarantine_operator_surface_2402.rs:182](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/quarantine_operator_surface_2402.rs#L182)::release_restores_the_row_and_leaves_a_signed_audit_row; [tests/quarantine_operator_surface_2402.rs:257](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/quarantine_operator_surface_2402.rs#L257)::release_does_not_revive_a_tombstoned_row; [tests/quarantine_operator_surface_2402.rs:283](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/quarantine_operator_surface_2402.rs#L283)::release_is_fenced_by_the_record_stop.

**Competitor finding:** 0. No equivalent established at this scope in the assessed source corpus. Other systems have governed state changes; no release-plus-signed-event atomic transaction equivalent established. The safe explicit operator path must be distinguished from ai-memory's defective automatic dequarantine paths.

**Competitor code evidence:** [K@129](#e-k-129) ([source 1](https://github.com/ldclabs/anda-db/blob/d781b47b646076c3b17a2b20cfc44128f43c8124/rs/anda_cognitive_nexus/src/governance/auth.rs#L1-L34); [source 2](https://github.com/ldclabs/anda-db/blob/d781b47b646076c3b17a2b20cfc44128f43c8124/rs/anda_cognitive_nexus/src/governance/decision.rs#L488-L542)); [CL@88](#e-cl-88) ([source 1](https://github.com/sheawinkler/ContextLattice/blob/e0daa914fc3f3a9a21363470242ea3fc0bd88964/services/gateway-go/retrieval_receipts.go#L125); [source 2](https://github.com/sheawinkler/ContextLattice/blob/e0daa914fc3f3a9a21363470242ea3fc0bd88964/services/gateway-go/write_secret_filter.go#L20)).

**Open defects / gates:** [#3901](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/3901), [#3943](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/3943), [#4017](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/4017). Exact titles, labels and scope caveats are in §6.3.

**Release qualification:** Operator release couples state and audit, but automatic release can authenticate a different winning record. The safe helper does not repair that lane. Open: #3901, #3943, #4017. Issue scope/types are in the facet record.

**Claim boundary:** #3901 is directly visible: an attested cross-ID title collision can release a different row. #4017 shows same-ID is also insufficient evidence that the stored winning surface is the attested surface. Do not merge the safe operator property with a claim that automatic release is safe.

**Issue applicability:** [#3901](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/3901) [IMPLEMENTATION-REPORT]; [#3943](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/3943) [IMPLEMENTATION-REPORT]; [#4017](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/4017) [IMPLEMENTATION-REPORT]. #### F1-38 — SQLite pre-upgrade snapshot and atomic migration ladder


**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 2/3, HIGH 1/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** SQLite pre-upgrade snapshot and atomic migration ladder.

**Implementing symbols:** snapshot_before_migration [src/storage/migrations.rs:1145](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/migrations.rs#L1145); migrate [src/storage/migrations.rs:1865](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/migrations.rs#L1865); exclusive begin [src/storage/migrations.rs:1944](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/migrations.rs#L1944); schema stamp/commit [src/storage/migrations.rs:4611](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/migrations.rs#L4611).

**Mechanism:**

1. Before upgrading an existing durable store, snapshot_before_migration uses VACUUM INTO a versioned, timestamped sibling file. Snapshot failure aborts before schema mutation; in-memory stores have no file snapshot.
2. The ladder executes under BEGIN EXCLUSIVE, checks final integrity and writes the tip schema stamp only before committing the complete migration. An error rolls back SQL changes while leaving the pre-upgrade backup available.

**Default / activation / configuration:** ON — Automatic SQLite open-time upgrade. No feature flag; CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION=100 in the inspected release.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [src/storage/migrations.rs:6692](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/migrations.rs#L6692)::migrate_rollback_path_on_failed_arm_propagates_error; [src/storage/migrations.rs:5381](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/migrations.rs#L5381)::snapshot_before_migration_is_noop_for_in_memory_db; [tests/archive_restore_cid_identity_2385.rs:221](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/archive_restore_cid_identity_2385.rs#L221)::v90_migration_is_idempotent_and_preserves_every_trigger_2385.

#### F1-47 — Per-record envelope-key erasure with honest erasure-kind attestation


**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 3/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Per-record envelope-key erasure with honest erasure-kind attestation.

**Implementing symbols:** seal_content_per_record [src/encryption/mod.rs:1130](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/encryption/mod.rs#L1130); crypto_erase_marker [src/encryption/mod.rs:1172](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/encryption/mod.rs#L1172); crypto_erase_record_envelope [src/storage/mod.rs:6890](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L6890); crypto_erase_and_attest [src/storage/mod.rs:6951](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L6951).

**Mechanism:**

1. seal_content_per_record generates a random DEK, encrypts content with ChaCha20-Poly1305 and a fresh nonce/AAD, wraps the DEK using the X25519/HKDF-SHA256 envelope path, then zeroizes the temporary DEK. Envelope version 0x03 carries the wrapped key and ciphertext.
2. crypto_erase_record_envelope replaces a live per-record envelope with marker 0x04. The transaction records key-destroyed only when this replacement occurred; plaintext/legacy per-agent envelopes record row-deleted-tombstoned instead, alongside deletion and signed-event append.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN — Per-record encryption requires AI_MEMORY_ENCRYPT_AT_REST=1 or its encryption config seed. Erasure invocation is explicit/hard-delete; plaintext default cannot provide per-record cryptographic erasure.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [tests/crypto_erase_1956.rs:130](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/crypto_erase_1956.rs#L130)::encrypted_record_reads_back_then_crypto_erase_makes_it_unrecoverable; [tests/crypto_erase_1956.rs:260](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/crypto_erase_1956.rs#L260)::plaintext_record_is_tombstoned_not_crypto_erased_honest_limit; [tests/crypto_erase_1956.rs:295](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/crypto_erase_1956.rs#L295)::crypto_erase_persists_across_db_reopen.

**Competitor finding:** 0. No equivalent established at this scope in the assessed source corpus. #### F1-48 — Durable erasure intent from CLI/MCP to configured peers


**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · LOW (LOW 2/3, MEDIUM 1/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Durable erasure intent from CLI/MCP to configured peers.

**Implementing symbols:** mark_federation_drainable [src/federation/erasure_outbox.rs:233](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/federation/erasure_outbox.rs#L233); enqueue_erasure [src/federation/erasure_outbox.rs:342](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/federation/erasure_outbox.rs#L342); enqueue_erasures [src/federation/erasure_outbox.rs:353](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/federation/erasure_outbox.rs#L353); expand_erasure_sentinel_row [src/federation/push_dlq.rs:1057](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/federation/push_dlq.rs#L1057).

**Mechanism:**

1. A daemon writes a drainability marker for a database with federation peers. CLI/MCP delete/forget can then enqueue an identity-only erasure sentinel into the persistent push DLQ without knowing the live peer list.
2. The drainer expands the sentinel into per-peer deletion work and sends it using the normal signed push path; down peers retain pending rows. A later restore can supersede a queued delete according to timestamp checks.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN — Federation daemon with configured peers and active replay/catchup worker required. --catchup-interval-secs controls scheduling; absent drainability marker queues nothing.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [tests/federation_erasure_replication_2446.rs:397](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/federation_erasure_replication_2446.rs#L397)::mcp_memory_forget_queues_erasure_outbox_rows_2446; [tests/federation_erasure_replication_2446.rs:582](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/federation_erasure_replication_2446.rs#L582)::drain_expands_sentinel_and_delivers_deletion_to_peer_2446; [tests/federation_erasure_replication_2446.rs:658](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/federation_erasure_replication_2446.rs#L658)::peer_down_leaves_the_expanded_row_pending_2446.

**Competitor finding:** 0. No equivalent established at this scope in the assessed source corpus. Store-and-forward and replicated deletes are adjacent; no identity-only erasure intent fan-out equivalent with these CLI/MCP semantics established. The interval-zero drainability defect means even configured outbox intent may never leave the node.

**Competitor code evidence:** [OX@61](#e-ox-61) ([source 1](https://github.com/sageox/ox/blob/c7a76abe26e827fd2d3efed0abd82d49853a9782/internal/daemon/murmur_outbox.go#L29); [source 2](https://github.com/sageox/ox/blob/c7a76abe26e827fd2d3efed0abd82d49853a9782/internal/daemon/murmur_relay.go#L54)); [OV@127](#e-ov-127) ([source 1](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/blob/a09a9d20a8e07d08973aee177802d00e08df29e6/crates/ragfs/src/core/multibackend_wrapper.rs#L145-L158); [source 2](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/blob/a09a9d20a8e07d08973aee177802d00e08df29e6/crates/ragfs/src/core/multibackend_wrapper.rs#L237-L299)).

**Open defects / gates:** [#4029](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/4029), [#4067](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/4067). Exact titles, labels and scope caveats are in §6.3.

**Release qualification:** A durable intent is not delivery: the drainability marker can exist while the replay worker is disabled, and inbound tombstone races remain. Open: #4029, #4067. Issue scope/types are in the facet record.

**Claim boundary:** #4067: interval=0 can mark the database drainable while disabling the only worker. Enqueue is best effort and deliberately does not fail local erasure when the outbox is broken; this is not an atomic all-peers erase or guaranteed remote receipt collection.

**Issue applicability:** [#4029](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/4029) [IMPLEMENTATION-REPORT]; [#4067](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/issues/4067) [IMPLEMENTATION-REPORT]. Exact current titles appear in §6.3.

**Implementing symbols:** fetch_catchup_envelope [src/federation/receive.rs:98](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/federation/receive.rs#L98); read_capped_sync_json_inner [src/federation/receive.rs:283](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/federation/receive.rs#L283); resolve_catchup_advance [src/federation/receive.rs:346](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/federation/receive.rs#L346); catchup_once_with_store [src/federation/receive.rs:482](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/federation/receive.rs#L482); sync-since implementation [src/handlers/federation_sync_since.rs:379](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/handlers/federation_sync_since.rs#L379).

**Mechanism:**

1. The catchup loop signs GET /sync/since, caps response bytes before decoding, validates rows/namespace admission and records durable per-peer progress. A failed apply halts advancement beyond its successful prefix.
2. resolve_catchup_advance validates advertised next_since against current progress and rejects poisoned future cursors; filtered windows can still progress. The endpoint protects trailing same-timestamp groups from a simple timestamp cursor cutting through a page.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN — Configured peers and catchup interval. Signed GET gates default ON once used; --catchup-interval-secs=0 disables the periodic loop.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [src/federation/receive.rs:1413](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/federation/receive.rs#L1413)::oversize_sync_body_rejected_before_buffering; [src/federation/receive.rs:1293](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/federation/receive.rs#L1293)::halted_never_advances_to_next_since_2714; [tests/federation_sync_since_watermark_2441.rs:374](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/federation_sync_since_watermark_2441.rs#L374)::cursor_holds_rather_than_skipping_a_cut_tie_group_2441.

**Competitor finding:** 0. No equivalent established at this scope in the assessed source corpus. Incremental synchronization exists, but no full signed, size-bounded, progress-validated catchup equivalent established. ai-memory's null-cursor handling skips equal-timestamp pages, so its stronger intended contract is incomplete.

**Implementing symbols:** MemoryStore [src/store/mod.rs:1216](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/mod.rs#L1216); CallerContext [src/store/mod.rs:645](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/mod.rs#L645); StoreError [src/store/mod.rs:306](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/mod.rs#L306); Transaction [src/store/mod.rs:987](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/mod.rs#L987); begin_transaction [src/store/mod.rs:1947](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/store/mod.rs#L1947); feature declarations [Cargo.toml:312](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/Cargo.toml#L312).

**Mechanism:**

1. MemoryStore is an async Send+Sync trait over Memory, Filter, CallerContext, typed StoreError and capability flags. SqliteStore serializes a rusqlite connection; PostgresStore uses an SQLx pool and the same domain records.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN — Cargo default=[sqlite-bundled]. sal enables the abstraction; sal-postgres adds SQLx/pgvector. AI_MEMORY_STORE_URL / --store-url chooses PG at runtime in a capable build.

**Mechanism:**

1. canonicalize_attested_created_at renders a UTC microsecond form that survives PostgreSQL TIMESTAMPTZ readback unchanged; signing refuses unsupported renderings before storing an unverifiable signature. CID generation separately canonicalizes the same instant.

<a id="facet-f1-59"></a>
#### F1-59 — Opt-in Reed-Solomon archive reconstruction and shard self-repair


**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · LOW (LOW 3/3). **Code reality:** REAL-OPT-IN. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** No applicable report mapped in the two-label snapshot.

**What it is:** Opt-in Reed-Solomon archive reconstruction and shard self-repair.

**Implementing symbols:** encode_bundle [src/erasure/codec.rs:276](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/erasure/codec.rs#L276); reconstruct_bundle [src/erasure/codec.rs:404](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/erasure/codec.rs#L404); ErasureStore::prepare_put [src/erasure/store.rs:396](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/erasure/store.rs#L396); ErasureStore::get [src/erasure/store.rs:482](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/erasure/store.rs#L482); bundle_one_row [src/erasure/archive_sync.rs:893](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/erasure/archive_sync.rs#L893); try_restore_archived_row_from_bundle [src/erasure/archive_sync.rs:1062](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/erasure/archive_sync.rs#L1062); CLI GC call [src/cli/gc.rs:44](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/cli/gc.rs#L44); daemon GC call [src/daemon_runtime.rs:4638](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/daemon_runtime.rs#L4638).

**Mechanism:**

1. The SQLite archive sweep serializes an archived row, splits/pads it into k data shards and generates m Reed-Solomon parity shards. A manifest binds bundle ID, geometry, original length, per-shard SHA-256 and whole-payload SHA-256; shards and manifest are fsynced before publication.
2. Reads reject malformed/oversize manifests, treat missing or hash-invalid shards as erasures, require at least k valid shards, reconstruct missing data and verify the final payload hash. Within-budget degradation triggers a best-effort rewrite; archive restore can rematerialize a missing owned row inside its transaction.
3. The GC sweep prepares a bundle, takes the store coordination lock, checks purge intent and rechecks the archived_at snapshot before publishing. Existing bundles are decoded using their recorded geometry, not the current environment values.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN — AI_MEMORY_ERASURE_COLD_TIER=1; default OFF. AI_MEMORY_ERASURE_DATA_SHARDS defaults 4; AI_MEMORY_ERASURE_PARITY_SHARDS defaults 2; AI_MEMORY_ERASURE_DIR chooses the bundle root. Bundling occurs on bounded GC sweeps, not synchronously with every archive commit.

#### F1-60 — Durable purge intent distinguishes destroyed archives from unexplained database loss


**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 3/3). **Code reality:** REAL-OPT-IN. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Durable purge intent distinguishes destroyed archives from unexplained database loss.

**Implementing symbols:** purge_archive_matching [src/storage/mod.rs:17650](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/storage/mod.rs#L17650); ErasureStore::lock_exclusive [src/erasure/store.rs:299](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/erasure/store.rs#L299); journal_purge_intent [src/erasure/store.rs:694](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/erasure/store.rs#L694); reconcile_one_rowless [src/erasure/archive_sync.rs:1204](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/erasure/archive_sync.rs#L1204); reconcile_and_scrub [src/erasure/archive_sync.rs:1291](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/erasure/archive_sync.rs#L1291); scrub_one [src/erasure/archive_sync.rs:1175](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/erasure/archive_sync.rs#L1175).

**Mechanism:**

1. purge_archive_matching acquires the cross-process bundle lock, begins a SQLite IMMEDIATE transaction, enumerates exact candidate IDs and journals purge markers before deleting those IDs and committing. Marker failures abort the delete; failed post-commit bundle removal retains intent for reconciliation.
2. A restore refuses journaled IDs. The bounded reconciler rechecks live/archive existence under the same lock: a rowless journaled bundle is removed, while an unjournaled one is moved into quarantine and hidden from restore. Database probe errors leave the bundle untouched rather than being interpreted as absence.
3. Recovery mode returns quarantined bundles to the active store; scrubbing verifies current bundles and can regenerate damaged ones from durable archived rows. Stale aborted-purge markers have repair/reconciliation handling rather than remaining an indefinite destruction instruction.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN — Cold tier requires AI_MEMORY_ERASURE_COLD_TIER=1. Destruction coordination also applies when an existing bundle directory is detected after that switch is disabled. AI_MEMORY_ERASURE_RECOVER_QUARANTINE=1 separately enables recovery; default OFF.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs:546](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs#L546)::journaled_purge_orphan_is_reaped_and_not_resurrectable; [tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs:725](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs#L725)::prepared_stale_snapshot_cannot_publish_after_purge_and_compaction; [tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs:784](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs#L784)::unjournaled_dbloss_bundle_is_quarantined_not_destroyed_and_recoverable; [tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs:860](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs#L860)::row_probe_error_skips_bundle_instead_of_classifying_it_as_rowless; [tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs:951](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs#L951)::purge_marker_creation_failure_is_fail_closed; [tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs:1074](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/erasure_cold_tier_2064.rs#L1074)::aborted_purge_stale_marker_is_cleared_so_later_dbloss_quarantines.

**Mechanism:**

1. Admin-only mint/bind requires confidential transport and a registered target; mint draws 32 random bytes, while supplied tokens meet a 32-byte length floor. Persist SHA-256 only, return minted plaintext once with no-store, and audit a fingerprint; the mint limiter is per admitted principal.
2. Revoking another principal or the last enrolled key queues approval. Apply rechecks last-key safety with serialized storage admission; approval HMAC binds pending ID and approver. Self-revoke while other keys remain updates the live registry.
3. Requests snapshot an Arc<HashMap<token_hash,agent_id>> behind an RwLock; install replaces the map and increments its generation. Periodic reload defaults to 15 seconds; failure retains the prior map indefinitely and publication does not reject an older concurrent snapshot.

**Default / activation / configuration:** PARTIAL. AI_MEMORY_AGENT_KEY_REFRESH_SECS defaults 15; enrollment is opt-in; zero disables periodic refresh.

**Implementing symbols:** canonical_bytes_for_identity [src/mcp/server_identity.rs:150](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/mcp/server_identity.rs#L150); build_signed_identity [src/mcp/server_identity.rs:181](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/mcp/server_identity.rs#L181); verify_signed_identity [src/mcp/server_identity.rs:235](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/mcp/server_identity.rs#L235).

**Mechanism:**

1. Build a JSON identity tuple containing schema version, daemon ID, public key and signed_at; sign the deterministic serialized tuple with the available Ed25519 private key.
2. Return the block at initialization; verify_signed_identity checks shape and signature under the embedded public key. Missing/private-less keys omit the block rather than fabricate a signature.

**Default / activation / configuration:** PARTIAL. Automatic when the MCP server has a signing key; key custody via AI_MEMORY_KEY_DIR. Client trust enrollment/pinning is external to this verifier.

**Class/value:** TABLE-STAKES (TABLE-STAKES 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 2/3, HIGH 1/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Segment-aware team, unit and organization namespace scopes.

**Implementing symbols:** scope_subtree_visible [src/visibility.rs:468](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/visibility.rs#L468); namespace_subtree_contains [src/visibility.rs:489](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/visibility.rs#L489); namespace_read_scope_prefixes [src/visibility.rs:518](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/visibility.rs#L518); is_visible_to_scope_agent [src/visibility.rs:427](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/visibility.rs#L427).

**Mechanism:**

1. Map team/unit/org to successive caller namespace ancestors and admit a record only when its namespace equals that ancestor or is a slash-delimited descendant.

**Mechanism:**

1. Transport edges parse presented tokens once and attach them to CallerContext. The gate first evaluates ordinary governance, then considers a capability only for a pending Ask in enforce mode.

**Default / activation / configuration:** PARTIAL. AI_MEMORY_CAPABILITIES defaults on; [permissions].mode/enforcement and a presented token must engage the join. HTTP X-AI-Memory-Capability, MCP capability and CLI channels carry it.

**Mechanism:**

1. Sign a domain-separated pending-ID plus approve/deny decision. Resolve operator/additional approver keys, verify strict signatures and count distinct public keys against the threshold.
2. The stored requirement or namespace requirement arms the gate; presenting signatures also triggers verification. Insufficient quorum stays Pending; missing/forged/unenrolled proof refuses. A single-use execution exemption binds the approved execution to content identity.
3. The separate HTTP approval envelope requires HMAC-SHA256 under SHA256(subscription secret), over timestamp.method.pending_id.body, with a 300-second age/60-second future-skew window and constant-time comparison; a process-local signature cache rejects in-window replay.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN. AI_MEMORY_APPROVER_PUBKEYS plus operator key; AI_MEMORY_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD defaults 1. Stored/namespace signed-approval policy must require it, or caller presents proofs. HTTP approvals additionally require [hooks.subscription].hmac_secret; missing HMAC or server secret refuses even when general API-key auth is disabled.

**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 2/3, LOW 1/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Pre-client inference egress restriction and refusal evidence.

**Implementing symbols:** InferenceEgressMode [src/egress.rs:107](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/egress.rs#L107); resolve_inference_egress_mode [src/egress.rs:177](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/egress.rs#L177); target_is_loopback [src/egress.rs:224](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/egress.rs#L224); evaluate_inference_egress [src/egress.rs:314](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/egress.rs#L314); emit_inference_egress_refusal [src/egress.rs:365](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/egress.rs#L365).

**Mechanism:**

1. Classify LLM and embedding egress, resolve allow/loopback-only/deny, and evaluate the resolved endpoint before constructing clients. Deny rejects even localhost; loopback-only permits only the recognized local host forms.

**Mechanism:**

1. Mint a UUID and store the payload as a Memory in _inbox/<recipient>; retain the subject in metadata and append the id suffix to the stored title.
2. Charge the sender’s row/byte quota, call insert_no_overwrite, refund on insert failure, then emit agent_notified only after the durable insert.
3. Inbox dispatch binds the selected owner to the resolved caller; delivery is a stored row, not successful execution by the receiving agent.

**Default / activation / configuration:** ON.  Explicit notify/inbox operations; no hub required. MCP power/full profile exposes the tools. HTTP identity enforcement is separately configurable through the env-only AI_MEMORY_HTTP_REQUIRE_ATTESTED_IDENTITY; singleton defaults to advisory.

**Mechanism:**

1. Only an agent that completed Hello may acquire an offline pending entry.
2. Coalesce repeated row ids, retain a bounded id set and count/mark lag when it overflows; Welcome returns catch-up indicators and take clears the pending set.
3. A replaced route records a session id so the old session’s teardown cannot unregister the new connection; departed agents are forgotten.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN.  Automatic within an active hub; [wake_hub].pending_max_agents and pending_max_ids default to 1,024 known agents and 64 retained row ids per agent.

**Competitor finding:** 0. No equivalent established at this scope in the assessed source corpus. Offline/retry queues exist. **Mechanism:**

1. Local inference builds the in-process model; Ollama nomic and OpenAI-compatible endpoints use distinct wire shapes.
2. An API embedder requires a known or explicitly pinned positive vector width; explicit dim is also sent as requested output dimensions where supported.

<a id="facet-f3-14"></a>
#### F3-14 — Embedding-space identity and bounded query-embedding cache


**Class/value:** UNIQUE (UNIQUE 3/3) · MEDIUM (LOW 1/3, MEDIUM 2/3). **Code reality:** PARTIAL. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Embedding-space identity and bounded query-embedding cache.

**Implementing symbols:** [src/embeddings.rs:241](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/embeddings.rs#L241) query_embed_key; [src/embeddings.rs:288](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/embeddings.rs#L288) recall_query_embedding; [src/embeddings.rs:479](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/embeddings.rs#L479) embedding_space_fingerprint; [src/embeddings.rs:533](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/embeddings.rs#L533) set_active_embedding_space; [src/embeddings.rs:1710](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/embeddings.rs#L1710) cosine_similarity_checked; [src/embeddings.rs:1740](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/embeddings.rs#L1740) cosine_similarity_space_checked.

**Mechanism:**

1. Normalize model family spellings to a space fingerprint and carry the active fingerprint with vectors.
2. Refuse or flag dimension/space mismatches instead of treating equal-width vectors as interchangeable.
3. Key query-cache entries by text plus embedding space; bounded recall embedding returns no vector on failure/budget degradation so downstream retrieval can fall back.

**Default / activation / configuration:** ON.  Space checks apply when embedding is active. AI_MEMORY_QUERY_EMBED_CACHE_ENTRIES defaults to 512 entries (0 disables); cache TTL is 900 s. AI_MEMORY_RECALL_EMBED_BUDGET_MS defaults to 2000 ms (0 disables); unknown space avoids unsafe reuse.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [src/embeddings.rs:2263](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/embeddings.rs#L2263)::embedding_space_folds_known_family_spellings; [src/embeddings.rs:2325](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/embeddings.rs#L2325)::embedding_space_over_distinguishes_conservatively; [src/embeddings.rs:2610](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/embeddings.rs#L2610)::cosine_similarity_checked_flags_dimension_mismatch.

**Competitor finding:** 0. No equivalent established at this scope in the assessed source corpus. **Class/value:** TABLE-STAKES (TABLE-STAKES 3/3) · MEDIUM (MEDIUM 3/3). **Code reality:** REAL-OPT-IN. **Top-ten selections:** 0/3. **Defect status:** OPEN REPORTS / GATES.

**What it is:** Neural cross-encoder with lexical fallback, batching and score floors.

**Implementing symbols:** [src/reranker.rs:990](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/reranker.rs#L990) CrossEncoder::new_neural; [src/config.rs:9815](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/config.rs#L9815) resolve_reranker; [src/config.rs:9953](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/config.rs#L9953) resolve_reranker_score_floor; [src/daemon_runtime.rs:6940](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/daemon_runtime.rs#L6940) should_build_cross_encoder call; [src/daemon_runtime.rs:6945](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/daemon_runtime.rs#L6945) fixed neural constructor; [src/daemon_runtime.rs:6954](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/daemon_runtime.rs#L6954) BatchedReranker::with_score_floor.

**Mechanism:**

1. Load the shipped MS MARCO MiniLM cross-encoder, score query/document pairs and blend/reorder the recalled candidates.
2. A bounded worker pool batches work, caps candidates/sequence lengths and can preserve hybrid results when the budget is exceeded; neural load failure installs a marked lexical fallback.
3. Optional absolute/relative score floors trim the tail while preserving the top row; reflection boosts are retrieval heuristics, not model confidence.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN.  Autonomous tier or [reranker].enabled; [reranker].max_seq_tokens/score_floor and AI_MEMORY_RERANK_* tune bounds. Default semantic tier has no reranker; score floor defaults Off.

**Mechanism:**

1. Mutex<BreakerState> stores consecutive_failures and last_failure_at; eligible failures increment the counter and successful generation resets it.
2. Before chat, is_open fast-fails while count>=3 and the last failure is younger than 30 s; requests and synchronous bridges have bounded time budgets and capped response reads.
3. After cooldown, ordinary requests resume: there is no exclusive half-open ticket, generation/epoch ownership, or stale-completion fencing.

**Default / activation / configuration:** PARTIAL.  Automatic for a constructed OllamaClient; compiled threshold=3 and cooldown=30 s. No [decision] breaker configuration exists in this release.

**Pinning tests — source inspected, not executed:** [src/llm.rs:5077](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/llm.rs#L5077)::generate_fast_fails_after_breaker_trips; [tests/round2_f6_llm.rs:79](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/tests/round2_f6_llm.rs#L79)::chat_dispatch_times_out_cleanly_on_dead_endpoint; [src/llm.rs:5178](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/llm.rs#L5178)::breaker_stays_closed_under_threshold; [src/llm.rs:4067](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/llm.rs#L4067)::read_capped_bytes_rejects_oversize_1459.

**Mechanism:**

1. Classify inference egress and resolve allow/loopback-only/deny; unknown configured tokens fail closed to deny.

3. Allow permits remote HTTPS and loopback HTTP; loopback-only restricts target locality, while deny prevents the inference client path.

**Default / activation / configuration:** PARTIAL.  AI_MEMORY_INFERENCE_EGRESS defaults allow; loopback-only or deny opts into restriction. Every allow-mode off-host plaintext inference URL is refused by the current gate.

**Mechanism:**

1. Collect bounded candidates, filter internal/excluded namespaces and ineligible/previously-tagged content, and reserve a share of the LLM operation budget for later passes.
2. Auto-tag each eligible row and compare one adjacent same-namespace sibling for contradiction rather than scanning every pair.

**What it is:** Confidence decay and empirical calibration reports.

**Implementing symbols:** [src/confidence/decay.rs:32](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/confidence/decay.rs#L32) decay_enabled; [src/confidence/decay.rs:68](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/confidence/decay.rs#L68) half_life_for_namespace; [src/confidence/decay.rs:93](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/confidence/decay.rs#L93) decayed; [src/confidence/decay.rs:119](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/confidence/decay.rs#L119) apply_decay_touch; [src/confidence/calibrate.rs:112](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/confidence/calibrate.rs#L112) CalibrationAudience; [src/confidence/calibrate.rs:186](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/confidence/calibrate.rs#L186) PerSourceBaseline; [src/confidence/calibrate.rs:335](https://github.com/alphaonedev/ai-memory-mcp/blob/a1403c742f9d590a08b6fd170deec5f50ca8e940/src/confidence/calibrate.rs#L335) calibrate_from_shadow.

**Mechanism:**

1. Compute confidence as base*exp(-age*ln(2)/half_life), clamp future age to zero and the result to [0,1], and persist the decay timestamp.
2. Read shadow observations through caller visibility and aggregate per-source/namespace means, medians and ten buckets over a bounded time window.
3. Add consumption/access-divergence statistics only where ledger evidence exists; no provider token logprobs or destructive Permit threshold is involved.

**Default / activation / configuration:** OPT-IN.  AI_MEMORY_CONFIDENCE_DECAY=1 enables decay; namespace half-lives come from curator configuration. memory_calibrate_confidence is explicit and requires a resolvable audience.
